Sorry! The global save data was accidentally overwritten. We recommend backing up the save/setting.dat file in the root directory. If you need to recover it, it must be rewritten manually for each person. Affected players can send the setting.dat file along with the CGs, endings, and other items to be unlocked to cs@firedogstudio.com. Please understand that recovery will take some time.

notes.title: "NeveRossa ~Mille e una notte~ Remaster" Has Been Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185887/fad04ec51d2f87f78b79e15a058b5ea30a7348ee.jpg[/img]

This PC single-player game, released in 2005, has always been beloved by players. With a complete overhaul, it will lead players to revisit that nostalgic adventure journey. The electronic version of the complete strategy guide is also being released simultaneously as DLC. In celebration of Firedog Studio's 25th anniversary, we sincerely invite all players to step back into the Hundred Mile City and embark on a new chapter with Shiye and Lilies.

[h2]Story Background[/h2]
The story takes place on a night where scarlet snow falls, featuring the protagonist Shiye, an expert capable of solving a thousand problems. Driven by fate, he embarks on a journey to become a "Goddess Path." Shiye's sacred mission is to cultivate the cute goddess seed, Lilies, into an outstanding goddess, all of which will unfold over the next thousand nights.

[h2]Game Features[/h2]
"NeveRossa ~Mille e una notte~ Remaster" retains the essence of the original, enhancing the overall experience while improving graphics and resolution. The game includes five core systems, allowing players to explore and grow along different paths:

1. [b]Romance System[/b]: Engage in various love stories with nine different female characters, influencing the final outcome.
2. [b]Training System[/b]: Choose from 27 professions to help Lilies develop into the strongest goddess.
3. [b]Adventure System[/b]: Delve into unknown worlds and challenge the powerful sacred beasts of the four elements.
4. [b]Synthesis System[/b]: Unleash your creativity by synthesizing various items to enhance character abilities.
5. [b]Quest System[/b]: Solve the problems of the city’s residents to enhance Shiye's reputation as a renowned expert.

Players will assume the role of Shiye, influencing Lilies's growth through various choices and events within a thousand-night timeframe, achieving multiple different endings. Every choice in the game impacts character development, allowing players to experience rich interactivity and depth.

[h2]New Features in the Remaster Version[/h2]
[list]
[*] Significantly enhanced resolution support for a higher definition experience!
[*] The number of save slots increased to 100, compatible with Steam Cloud saving, so you don’t have to worry about losing your saves!
[*] Compatible with Xbox controllers, allowing you to freely switch between mouse, keyboard, and gamepad!
[*] New Game Plus feature that retains levels, items, outfits, and synthesis recipes, making it easier to complete all game elements!
[*] Multi-language support! You can switch between different languages in the settings. In addition to the current Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese (interface still in development), English, Japanese, and more are planned to be added!
[/list]
[h2]Now Come Explore! [/h2]
"NeveRossa ~Mille e una notte~ Remaster" and the DLC complete strategy guide have officially launched on the Steam platform. Whether you're a nostalgic player or a newcomer, you can find enjoyment in this game. Download it now and start your goddess cultivation journey!

[h2]Package Information[/h2]
"NeveRossa ~Mille e una notte~ Remaster Deluxe Edition (including the game and complete strategy guide)" is available at a 10% discount. By also owning the Steam versions of "Cupid Bistro!! MAX" and "Cupid Bistro!! 2," you will receive a total 20% discount on the "Firedog Studio Classic Full Set"!
